comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber; record places a pipe on V-stands.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires keyed unlocking, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, tightening, and response-guided iteration; record primarily requires supporting and aligning a pipe.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two constrained dynamic stops and no damage or setting drift. Record supplies no body, specs, alignment tolerance, stability criterion, or scoring rubric.
comparison.reason: Pipe placement/alignment does not test damper adjustment, locking, or dynamic stopping behavior.
